name: Goncharov
source:
Goncharov's story ended on a bridge, and one way or another, Sofia and Katya were there first. A (very) short VN game considering the relationship between two women tangled up in the greatest mafia movie of all time.

[From [url=https://excavatinglizard.itch.io/goncharov]Itch.io[/url]]

Visual novel adaptation of a [url=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/goncharov]Tumblr meme[/url] about a non-existent movie directed by Martin Scorsese.
translation:
冈察洛夫的故事在一座桥上结束，而不论事情如何发展，索菲娅和卡佳总是先一步来到那里。这是一部（非常）短篇视觉小说，讲述两名女性纠缠于史上最伟大的黑帮电影之中的关系。

[引自[url=https://excavatinglizard.itch.io/goncharov]Itch.io[/url]]

本作改编自一则[url=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/goncharov]Tumblr网络迷因[/url]：马丁·斯科塞斯导演了一部并不存在的电影。
